diagnosis.summary: The runtime configuration parameter config.tool_timeout_ms was set to an excessively low value of 1ms. When tool.lookup_order was called, it exceeded this 1ms threshold and timed out, returning an empty result which led the LLM to conclude the order could not be found.

diagnosis.suggested_fix: Increase config.tool_timeout_ms to a reasonable duration (e.g., 5000ms) to allow store tools sufficient time to complete their queries.
